journey.name: unpayable payment request endpoint
journey.description: Requires a linked fixture issuer that can bind a new request to a one-time on-chain address already recorded as paid by this payer, then issue a request for a fresh address. See README.md for setup; report this journey as blocked if that fixture is unavailable. Checks rejection feedback without sending another payment.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled and the fixture issuer saved as a contact and linked as identities
Have the issuer send a new one-time BTC request with a future expiration and its bound on-chain endpoint set to the address already paid by this payer
Wait for incoming preparation to finish; verify the loading confirmation closes and the unavailable-payment toast (id "PaymentRequestUnavailableToast") appears
Open the pending-request bell (id "PaymentRequestsBell") and verify the unpaid request remains listed
Tap Pay for that request and wait for preparation to finish
Verify the unavailable-payment toast (id "PaymentRequestUnavailableToast") appears and the request list or details return without a loading confirmation
Have the issuer send a different request bound to a fresh unused address
Verify the new request reaches confirmation rather than waiting behind the rejected request
Dismiss the confirmation without paying and verify no new payment was created
